retained_failures.details: Initial library 518 passed; archive 55/58. One old outage expectation still required immediate Overloaded, the repeated-expiry fixture raced cleanup of its previous request, and the unchanged 500-ms retry test missed its attempt-count bound under concurrent load.
Isolated expiry attempt one returned Overloaded because the previous expired slot was not yet released. The fixture now waits for readiness between independent attempts.
The existing I/O retry test passes unchanged alone and in the final four-worker suite; deadline and attempt-count assertion are unchanged.
Concurrent Cargo aliases caused the formatter helper not to launch. The serial retry passes; this is an invocation failure, not a formatting defect.

test_contract_changes: Outage tests now require unsubmitted deadline expiry (Unavailable), retaining exact callback counts, duplicate results, image-copy, byte-charge and restart/recovery assertions. New task timeout cleanup retains handles until joined.
